newsitem.title: USA: America Online stake cut by FMR Corp.
newsitem.headline: America Online stake cut by FMR Corp.

text.p: A group led by FMR Corp said in a Securities and Exchange Commission filing Tuesday it reduced its stake in America Online Inc to 4,776,220 common shares or 5.12 percent from 11.13 percent held previously.
The group disclosed its latest position on America Online in a 13G filing. FMR Corp is the parent of the investment adviser to Fidelity Funds.
Filings under 13G are usually made by institutions and large investors with "passive" investment objectives in a company. Unlike 13D filings, those reports do not list the latest transactions.
